title: Custom Cherrypicking from CSV
author: Opentrons
materials: Aspirate DNA volume based on CSV.

steps.title: Pick up tip
steps.instruction: Using the p300 single‑channel pipette, pick up a fresh tip from the location indicated in the CSV file.

steps.title: Aspirate DNA
steps.instruction: Aspirate the DNA volume specified for the current CSV line from the indicated source‑plate well.

steps.title: Aspirate air gap
steps.instruction: Aspirate an additional 5 µL of air to create an air gap.

steps.title: Transfer DNA to destination
steps.instruction: Move to the destination‑plate well specified in the CSV and dispense the entire aspirated volume (DNA plus air gap) toward the bottom of the well.

steps.title: Discard tip
steps.instruction: Eject the used tip into the trash.

steps.title: Repeat for all rows
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 1‑5 for each subsequent line in the CSV until all transfers are completed.
